paragraphs.text: Kudo , King Among Bears , is a legendary Bear from an unknown plane introduced in Modern Horizons 3 . He is the consort of Ayula . The word "King" is a metaphorical description, rather than a title.

Kudo is a legendary bear. It is said he was born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, and crowned amid a raging blizzard. He leaves runic claw marks that ensure his territories are never left defenseless. Kudo, like Ayula, has mostly brown fur on his body except for a lighter patch across his chest and shoulders. He has a small crown of 6 horns atop his head.
Kudo's personality is calmer than Ayula's. Where she is firey and aggressive, Kudo is warm and loving.
